# Classtime

> > Classtime is a digital classroom platform that enables teachers to create engaging, data-driven learning experiences through real-time assessment and collaborative activities.

Classtime provides educators with tools for implementing differentiated instruction, collaborative learning, and data-backed teaching strategies. The platform supports various blended learning models and helps teachers create inclusive, equitable classroom environments while preparing students for standardized assessments.

## Key Topics

- Differentiated Instruction
- Collaborative Learning
- Student Engagement
- Data-Driven Teaching
- Blended Learning
- Professional Learning Communities
- Student Assessment
- Classroom Management
- Learning Analytics
- Digital Classroom Activities
- Teaching Strategies
- Learning Gaps
- Executive Functioning
- Standardized Test Preparation
